run_export_tasks: run the script to export a library to supported tasks mapping in JSON format
traverse_global_assignments: traverse all global assignments in a Python file and apply a handler callback to each
extract_tasks: extract supported task keys from an ALLOWED_TASKS variable in a library's source code
summarize_lib_to_task_map: summarize the library to task mapping defaultdict that stores each library's supported tasks
review_traverse_global_assignments: review the traverse_global_assignments function that parses AST and handles both annotated and plain assignments
